messages:
Sam (devex): heads up — after the 0.4.0 package publish a bunch of our onboarding/sample apps fail in edge runtimes with `Error: No matching export` when importing from `@redwood/inference-sdk`. repro steps below, this started in the canary -> prod cut :thinking:

Leah (eng-runtime): ugh. do you have the exact error + the package.json `exports` snippet?

Sam (devex): stack trace from Cloudflare:
```
Error: No matching export in 'node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk/package.json' for './edge'
    at importAssertions (worker-runtime.js:32:12)
    at ModuleJob.run (internal/modules/esm/module_job.js:127:37)
```
package.json (published):
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-sdk",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "dist/index.esm.js",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./node": "./dist/node.js",
    "./edge": "./dist/edge.mjs"
  }
}
```
But Cloudflare error says the export isn't being matched even though `./edge` exists. :eyes:

Leah (eng-runtime): hm. could be conditional exports order or the consumer bundler resolves to CJS path first. which entrypoint are the sample apps importing? direct `import { Client } from '@redwood/inference-sdk/edge'` or top-level `from '@redwood/inference-sdk'`?

Sam (devex): sample-apps (next + wrangler) use `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk/edge'` explicitly. same import used to work on 0.3.x. quick diff shows we added an explicit `./node` key and the `exports` shape changed from wildcard to explicit map in 0.4.0.

Marcus (eng-ml): wildcard -> explicit maps can break subpath imports when consumers expect directory index resolution. Cloudflare/Workers uses an ES module loader that is strict about exports and subpath patterns. If the consumer uses `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge/index.mjs` somewhere, that won't match.

Sam (devex): also noticed TypeScript types stop resolving for `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` in some editors. `index.d.ts` has only top-level exports, not `edge.d.ts`. so typings + runtime both mismatched.

CI-bot: build failed: sample-apps/next-onboarding (cloudflare-worker) — import-resolution-error — see job 4832

Ava (devex): can we hotfix? two options: (1) add explicit `./edge` export with correct conditions for `import`/`default` and add `types` for the subpath, or (2) revert to wildcard exports until we write tests. leaning 1.

Leah (eng-runtime): prefer (1). but important: the order of conditional keys matters. Cloudflare's loader will match `import`/`default` condition sets differently than node/browser. Add a "conditionless" fallback for older loaders: "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "default": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" } and include a `types` entry: "./edge.d.ts": "dist/edge.d.ts" (or set `typesVersions`). Also add a tiny worker test that imports the exact subpath.

Sam (devex): okay I'll open a PR with the export+types fix + test that runs in the sample-apps CI matrix. quick patch diff I'm planning:
```
"exports": {
  "./package.json": "./package.json",
  "./node": { "require": "./dist/node.cjs.js", "import": "./dist/node.mjs" },
  "./edge": { "import": "./dist/edge.mjs", "default": "./dist/edge.cjs.js" },
  "./*": "./dist/*.js"
},
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
"typesVersions": {
  "*": { "edge": ["dist/edge.d.ts"] }
}
```

Marcus (eng-ml): please also add a dev-dependency test that runs in Bun + Cloudflare + node ESM to catch regressions. we missed that earlier.

Leah (eng-runtime): note: some bundlers (older rollup/webpack) ignore conditional `default` shapes. adding `./edge` explicit file at package root that re-exports might be the safest short-term: `edge.js` -> `export * from './dist/edge.mjs'` and include `edge.cjs.js` for require. then keep exports mapping simple.

Sam (devex): makes sense. created PR #1245 with both: edge proxy file + exports map + edge.d.ts. running CI now. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1245 :shipit:

CI-bot: PR 1245 — checks started: unit, sample-apps, node-compat matrix.

Ava (devex): once CI is green let's cut a 0.4.1 canary and announce a migration note for sample-app authors: how to import subpaths and what changed. also add a note in onboarding README about `@redwood/inference-sdk/edge` typings.

Leah (eng-runtime): agreed. long-term we should add automation that runs `npm pack` and verifies `exports` subpath resolution in a Cloudflare worker runtime as part of release CI.

Sam (devex): update — canary published 0.4.1-canary.8, sample-apps cloudflare worker test passed locally — loading in production cloudflare now fine. will monitor errors for next 24h. :thumbsup:

Leah (eng-runtime): awesome, thanks for the quick turnaround. let's follow up with a postmortem about the missing sample-apps runner in release gating. assign to me.

Sam (devex): noted. moving the thread to postmortem once we have CI logs.

(reacts: :eyes: :shipit:)
